nom: DIME Dewy Recovery Mask with NAD+

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin say the extra hydration helps rather than adding shine, and it doesn't leave their oilier areas feeling greasy the next day.
segments.dry: An overwhelming number of reviewers with dry, flaky, or winter-parched skin, including some managing menopause-related dryness, report the mask relieves dryness and peeling, often after just one use, and works especially well left on overnight; one long-time DIME user, however, finds it too heavy to sleep in and prefers it as a 15-minute mask instead.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, mature skin says it hydrates the drier areas of her face without making her oilier spots feel greasy.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who react to many products, report fast results without irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 60s and 70s say it keeps their skin soft and hydrated, though one 75-year-old notes it won't undo her wrinkles.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, many with dry or winter-parched skin, report significant, often immediate relief from dryness, flaking, and tightness, with soft, hydrated, glowing skin the next morning; one reviewer says it feels too heavy to sleep in and prefers a shorter mask application instead.
concerns.aging: Several reviewers say fine lines, including the '11' lines and forehead lines, look softer or temporarily smoothed after use; one 75-year-old reviewer says it hydrates well but won't erase her wrinkles.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin, several expecting it to cause breakouts, report it has not broken them out and even helped calm existing blemishes; one reviewer, though, noticed a few mild blemishes appear the day after use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with extremely dry skin says her face looked less red the morning after an overnight application.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers managing oiliness say the mask adds hydration without making oily areas feel greasier or shinier the next day.

aspects.libelle: Feels rich but absorbs without residue
Large jar, goes a long way
Doubles as overnight or quick mask
Can feel sticky or tacky overnight

extraits.texte: I generally really liked this mask made my face soft and hydrated. The only thing was i notice a few blemishes pop up a day later but mild.

Almost everything Dime makes agrees with my skin, so when this came out I had to order it. This doesn't work as an overnight mask for me, it is too heavy for some reason, my skin doesn't like it on through the night. Not sure why because it feels divine, it's dense without feeling icky. So in my routine I use it as a 15 min mask. It's great and helps give me the moisture and glow I need.

I have combination, mature skin, and this mask has been a nice addition to my routine. It hydrates the dry areas without making the oily spots feel greasy. I wake up with softer, smoother skin and a healthy, dewy glow. It's simple, gentle, and works well for a weekly boost of moisture.

I have tried countless face masks in hopes of finding one that agrees and isn't too harsh with my sensitive, dry winter skin - and this is a SLAM DUNK! I am so thankful to have this product in my routine and it has done wonders for my skin.

extraits.titre: My go to Bed time Mask!
extraits.texte: I live in a dry climate and I am 65 years plus. I apply this Dewy Recovery Mask every evening to my face and neck area. It is wonderful! I love Dime products.
I've enjoyed using this mask. I leave it on all night. Skin feels great. But nothing will fix 75 year old wrinkles. ;-) i would consider buying again.

I just received the Dewy Recovery Mask on Monday. I tried it last night (Tuesday). I used my favorite cleanser (sorry. . . not a DIME cleanser) and the DIME Toner. I applied the DIME Hyaloronic Acid Serum as I do every night and skipped the other Serums and Moisturizers. I applied the Mask and left it on all night and rinsed my face with warm water. My skin looks FANTASTIC!!! I will see how it goes but I might replace the Restorative Night Cream for this three times a week. My skin is plump and my 11 o'clock lines and my beginnings of forehead lines were non-existant! I did not rewash my face, I just rinsed with warm water and applied my DIME Toner and my morning DIME regimine of Serums and Dewy Day Cream. I did not even have to put as much Dewy Day Cream on. This is wonderful!!! Another A+++
